robot: DeepRobotics X30 shared kinematic base (official vendor model, used for X30 Pro simulation)
limitations: The official repository calls this shared 12-actuated-joint X30 model. It ships joints without free-base or actuator definitions, so this profile adds bounded force motors, a free base, and a position-PD controller only in memory. X30 Pro-specific compute, LiDAR, cameras, thermal payloads, and optional RTK are not represented.
